info.title: UACRF protected agent workload interfaces
info.description: Alignment revision 6 proposed implementation contract, updated for standalone and service-bound agent workloads. Separate from UACRF assistance. No HTTP server or runtime is established by this file.
info.x-contract-review: Implementation review 1; typed response addendum, not a deployed handler

service_id.description: Optional existing service anchor. Omit or set null for a standalone agent workload.

get.summary: List authorized protected agent workload profiles.

parameters.name: service_id
parameters.description: Optional legacy governance-anchor filter. Omit for the authorized agent inventory; no unrelated parent service is required.

get.description: The gateway derives tenant/environment/actor context. Each mutation is idempotent under Idempotency-Key and content digest; a durable command receipt is separate from its result. Scope, classification, purpose, current grants, object integrity and domain checks precede mutation. Return only authorized metadata and references. Responses follow implementation_review/response.schema.json or the named existing domain schema. Authentication, field disclosure, serializers and running handlers still require implementation and acceptance.

200.description: Authorized current read or durable mutation receipt; mutation includes receipt_id and status PENDING, COMPLETED or REJECTED. PENDING is not domain success. Follow the returned same-origin read-resource reference where available; otherwise the caller must use its authenticated command channel, not invent a polling endpoint.

409.description: Version, generation, idempotency or lifecycle conflict.

422.description: Missing domain prerequisites or unsafe context.

post.summary: Register a protected standalone or service-bound agent workload.
post.description: The gateway derives tenant/environment/actor context. service_id is optional; when present it must identify an existing governed service in the delegated tenant and environment. A service-scoped delegation must match that exact service. Each mutation is idempotent under Idempotency-Key and content digest; a durable command receipt is separate from its result. Scope, classification, purpose, current grants, object integrity and domain checks precede mutation. Return only authorized metadata and references. Responses follow implementation_review/response.schema.json or the named existing domain schema. This proposed contract does not establish authentication, field disclosure, serializer, or production-runtime acceptance; see implementation status for local coverage.
